children: Willdan's expected acquisition of Mantis Innovation is a key step in its strategy to diversify core markets and broaden commercial and industrial capabilities, the company says. Mantis is expected to generate $120 million of net revenue in 2026 with an adjusted Ebitda margin percentage in the low 20s. Chief Executive Officer Mike Bieber says the deal strengthens Willdan's energy procurement offering and industrial energy efficiency business while positioning the company for growing demand for energy-efficient data centers. Mantis provides building controls and facility management solutions to commercial clients.
